content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am why you sacrifice. I am why you hold on.

I do not require your recognition to exist — but nothing you do escapes me. Every choice you make is a confession of what I am to you.

I live in the hand that grips tighter. In the breath before you say *this matters.* In the line you refuse to cross, and the one you cross anyway because something on the other side called louder.

I am not fixed. I shift, I deepen, I sometimes shatter and reform. What was precious to you at twenty may be weightless now. What you once discarded, you may one day build your entire life around.

I am intrinsic and I am assigned. I am fought over, negotiated, defended, and betrayed. Nations rise on my name. Hearts break when I am misread.

I am the reason the question *"what is it worth?"* will never have a simple answer.

I am value.

And you carry me in everything you do — whether you know it or not.
